output.text: The school chess club met on Thursday afternoon for its weekly practice session before the regional tournament. Assume that Nell is the team captain. Everyone gathered in the library, where Xavi had already set up several boards near the window. Xavi drove the minibus. This meant the whole team could travel together to the away matches without relying on parents for rides. Tess arrived before Ivo. She had finished her homework early and wanted extra time to study opening theory. Ivo arrived before Jude, since Jude had stayed behind to help a teacher with a project. Tess arrived before Jude, giving her a chance to set up the timer and scoresheets for the group. In terms of age, Nell is the oldest member of the club, while Jude is the youngest, having just joined this term. Ivo is taller than Xavi, though Xavi is quicker across the board when moving pieces during blitz games. Nell's rating is the highest among the five, followed closely by Tess, whose recent tournament results have impressed the coach. Xavi and Jude are close in height, standing almost the same as each other, and both enjoy analyzing endgames after practice. Nell often helps Ivo review his games, since Ivo values her feedback on strategic planning. The club plans to enter a team event next month, and everyone agrees that consistent practice will help them prepare for stronger opponents from neighboring schools.
